Future Outlook The Company has continued to gradually improve its performance over the last two years.
There are still challenges but given our sound financial position, the company will continue to grow.
Going forward the business environment and performance will be directly affected by the on-going tensions in the Middle East.
Keeping in view short term and long term outlook of each sector, management has taken into consideration the factors while determining required provisions against financial assets where required.
